answer: The go-to antibiotic for a child with an ear infection (acute otitis media) is amoxicillin [CDC, 2024]. It is typically prescribed as a first-line treatment due to its effectiveness and safety profile in children. The usual dose is 45 mg/kg/day divided into two doses, with a duration of 7 to 10 days, depending on the severity of the infection. If the infection is severe or if the child is allergic to penicillin, alternatives like cephalosporins or clindamycin may be considered [CDC, 2024]. Always consult a healthcare provider for personalized guidance.
